report.answer_text:
Nvidia was the first company to reach a $5 trillion market value. It did so on Wednesday, October 29, 2025.
Nvidia's shares rose 3% to close at $207.04 that day, which gave it a market value of $5.03 trillion.[1]
It crossed the threshold less than four months after it reached $4 trillion in July.[2]
AI chip demand drove the rise. It came shortly after CEO Jensen Huang said Nvidia expects $500 billion in AI chip orders.[3]
Nvidia didn't stay above $5 trillion. One tracker reports that Apple is now the most valuable company at roughly $5.2 trillion, ahead of Nvidia at roughly $4.2 trillion[4]. Those figures are from November 11, 2026.
